fitted_on: 6216 CL/EL/ECL group and league-phase matches, 1993-2026, Poisson MLE

championship_backtest_2004_2024.favourite_check: model favourite won 2/18 real seasons; model expected 4.0 at tau=3.5 — binomially compatible (P(<=2 | p=0.22, n=18) ~ 8%) but worth rechecking as seasons accrue

notes: coeff5 (5y European results) adds nothing once site_score is in (collinear, negative CV weight); dom_comp (domestic goal ratios) is non-monotone across leagues and near-zero at match level — the Sporting failure mode. Home advantage in European group play is genuinely small (hfa 0.035 log-goals). Z-scores are standardized within the season's CL+EL+ECL league-phase field to match training. tau=3.5 rescales the match-level MLE slope to season level: noisy features attenuate per-match fits, and the championship backtest (real 2004-2024 groups, actual champions' likelihood) is the season-level calibration.
z_field: CL league-phase participants only (36 clubs), matching the backtest convention
